preconditions.description: The graph has between 1 and 2000 vertices and between 0 and 100,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi for ai, bi in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct vertices within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: len(set((min(ai, bi), max(ai, bi)) for ai, bi in edges)) == m
preconditions.description: The input graph has no multiple edges between the same pair of vertices.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimal number of merging operations.
If the graph is already a caterpillar, the output is 0; otherwise, it is the minimal number of operations to make it a caterpillar.

postconditions.expression: all(is_caterpillar(merge_vertices(adjacency_list, a, b)) for a, b in possible_merges if output == 1) or all(is_caterpillar(merge_vertices(merge_vertices(adjacency_list, a, b), c, d)) for a, b in possible_merges for c, d in possible_merges if output == 2)
postconditions.description: The output is the minimal number of operations such that after applying that many merges, the graph becomes a caterpillar.
